description: Stripe provides financial infrastructure for businesses, including online and in-person payments, billing, payouts, and related money-management products. Its platform supports businesses building payment, subscription, marketplace, treasury, and other financial workflows.
summary: Stripe exposes a REST HTTP API at https://api.stripe.com, an OAuth-protected MCP server at https://mcp.stripe.com, and the `stripe` CLI; all require Stripe-issued credentials.
